title: Basic Science Quiz
description: A simple quiz on general science concepts.

questions.text: What is the chemical symbol for water?
questions.explanation: Water is H₂O — two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom.

questions.text: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.text: Which keyword declares a constant in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: `const` declares a variable that cannot be reassigned.
